disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certification or registration contained in this act or board regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or standards for a license, certification or registration contained in this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in practice or in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent representations in the practice of the profession or practicing fraud or deceit, either alone or as a conspirator, in obtaining a license, certification or registration or in obtaining admission to a medical college.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of a felony or of a misdemeanor relating to a health profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of a felony or being convicted of a misdemeanor relating to a health profession or receiving probation without verdict, disposition in lieu of trial or an Accelerated Rehabilitative Disposition in the disposition of felony charges.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or other disciplinary action taken by a licensing authority in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license or other authorization to practice the profession revoked or suspended or having other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license or other authorization refused, revoked or suspended by a proper licensing authority of another state, territory, possession or country, or a branch of the Federal Government.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, addiction, felony conviction, or mental incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice the profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, addiction to drugs or alcohol, having been convicted of a felonious act prohibited by the act of April 14, 1972 (P.L.233, No.64), known as The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful regulation or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful regulation promulgated by the board or violating a lawful order of the board previously entered by the board in a disciplinary proceeding.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection with a violator of this act or aiding unlicensed practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection or association with any person who is in violation of this act or regulations of the board or knowingly aiding, assisting, procuring or advising any unlicensed person to practice a profession contrary to this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from ethical or quality standards of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include departure from or failing to conform to an ethical or quality standard of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner that presents an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in such manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting outside the scope of a license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting outside the scope of a license or certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or deceptive biennial registration with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or deceptive biennial registration with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain required professional liability insurance coverage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain insurance coverage as required shall subject the licensee to disciplinary proceedings.

insurance_required.quote: A licensed perfusionist practicing in this Commonwealth shall maintain a level of professional liability insurance coverage in the minimum amount of $1,000,000 per occurrence or claims made.

definition_quote.value: The functions necessary for the support, treatment, measurement or supplementation of the cardiovascular system or other organs, or a combination of those functions, and for ensuring the safe management of physiologic functions by monitoring and analyzing the parameters of the systems under the supervision of a physician licensed under this act or the act of October 5, 1978 (P.L.1109, No.261), known as the Osteopathic Medical Practice Act.
definition_quote.quote: The functions necessary for the support, treatment, measurement or supplementation of the cardiovascular system or other organs, or a combination of those functions, and for ensuring the safe management of physiologic functions by monitoring and analyzing the parameters of the systems under the supervision of a physician licensed under this act or the act of October 5, 1978 (P.L.1109, No.261), known as the Osteopathic Medical Practice Act.

value: Extracorporeal circulation, long-term cardiopulmonary support techniques including extracorporeal carbon dioxide removal and extracorporeal membrane oxygenation
Counterpulsion, ventricular assistance, autotransfusion, blood and blood component conservation techniques, myocardial and organ preservation, extracorporeal life support and isolated limb perfusion
Blood and blood component management techniques, advanced life support and other related functions
Administration of pharmacological and therapeutic agents
Administration of blood products or anesthetic agents through the extracorporeal circuit or through an intravenous line in conjunction with extracorporeal support under physician supervision
Blood gas and chemistry monitoring and analysis
Hemodialysis in conjunction with perfusion service
Observation of signs and symptoms, determination of abnormal characteristics, and implementation of reporting, perfusion protocols or emergency procedures
methods_authorized.quote: These services shall include: (1) The use of extracorporeal circulation, long-term cardiopulmonary support techniques, including extracorporeal carbon dioxide removal, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation and associated therapeutic and diagnostic techniques. (2) Counterpulsion, ventricular assistance, autotransfusion, blood and blood component conservation techniques, myocardial and organ preservation, extracorporeal life support and isolated limb perfusion. (3) Blood and blood component management techniques, advanced life support and other related functions.

drug_authority.value: A perfusionist may administer pharmacological and therapeutic agents, blood products, or anesthetic agents through the extracorporeal circuit or through an intravenous line in conjunction with extracorporeal support, under the supervision of the treating physician.
drug_authority.quote: The administration of: (A) Pharmacological and therapeutic agents. (B) Blood products or anesthetic agents through the extracorporeal circuit or through an intravenous line in conjunction with extracorporeal support, under the supervision of the treating physician.

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: The license shall be issued for a period of one year and shall be nonrenewable.

graduate_perfusionist_title.quote: The board may issue a temporary graduate license to practice perfusion to an individual who has graduated from an educational program that complies with the education requirements of this act.

physician_supervision_required.quote: A perfusionist may perform perfusion on an individual being treated by a physician licensed under this act or the act of October 5, 1978 (P.L.1109, No.261), known as the Osteopathic Medical Practice Act under medical supervision and approval consistent with standing orders or protocols of a hospital that are promulgated and approved by the physician designated as the medical director of the cardiovascular surgery program.

student_supervision_model.quote: is performed under the direct supervision of a perfusionist who is assigned to supervise the student and who is on duty and immediately available in the assigned patient care area.

ecmo_monitoring_exemption.quote: A person who: (i) is trained according to the extracorporeal membrane oxygenation specialist guidelines of the Extracorporeal Life Support Organization; and (ii) operates an extracorporeal membrane oxygenation circuit under the supervision of a licensed physician.
